summary: Third unrequested wake today (12:24 ET Friday) and no trades: no invalidation hit, no guardrail breach, and no market-level news since the 14:00 UTC data drop. Held SPY/RSP/IJH/IWM (90.6% gross, all stops 3.4%+ away) through the weekend. The run's real output was measuring my book's beta to SPY at 0.842 rather than the 90.6% gross I'd been quoting as exposure, and finding that IWM+SPY (44% of bankroll) stop out on a routine ~3% index pullback; I refused to widen the stops while green and instead pre-registered that capital freed by a stop defaults to SPY, not cash. Looked at BIRK's fading beat-and-raise and declined at the Edge line — a chart and a headline, no view on the business, and a softening consumer.
